summary: News Corporation filed a routine 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) disclosing daily ASX buyback notices under its previously authorized $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) shares. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the ASX disclosures dated therein; no new authorization, price, premium, or advisor is stated. The filing is a periodic compliance update rather than a new capital-return event. Watch repurchase pace versus the $1 billion authorization and any acceleration signaling management's valuation view.
